title: Apricot Tagine Chicken
description: A twist on traditional Japanese cuisine, this apricot tagine chicken is a sweet and savory dish that combines the flavors of East meets West. The apricot adds a unique flavor dimension to this delicious dish.

ingredients.name: apricot tagine sauce
ingredients.notes: see below for homemade sauce ingredients

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken breast to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the apricot tagine sauce, soy sauce, and sugar to the saucepan. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Once the chicken is done, brush the apricot tagine sauce all over the chicken breast.
Transfer the chicken breast to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve the chicken breast with steamed rice or noodles and enjoy!

To make homemade apricot tagine sauce, combine the following ingredients in a blender or food processor: 1 cup of apricot jam, 1/4 cup of olive oil, 2 cloves of garlic, 1 tablespoon of grated ginger, and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice. Blend until smooth and adjust seasoning as needed.
